entries.title: I Samuel 28:1
segments: ¶Now it happened in those days that the Philistines gathered their armies together for war, to fight with Israel. And Achish said to David, "You assuredly know that you will go out with me to battle, you and your men."

entries.title: I Samuel 28:2
segments: And David said to Achish, "Surely you know what your servant can do." And Achish said to David, "Therefore I will make you one of my chief guardians forever."

entries.title: I Samuel 28:3
segments: Now Samuel had died, and all Israel had lamented for him and buried him in Ramah, in his own city. And Saul had put the mediums and the spiritists out of the land.

entries.title: I Samuel 28:4
segments: Then the Philistines gathered together, and came and encamped at Shunem. So Saul gathered all Israel together, and they encamped at Gilboa.

entries.title: I Samuel 28:5
segments: When Saul saw the army of the Philistines, he was afraid, and his heart trembled greatly.

entries.title: I Samuel 28:6
segments: And when Saul inquired of the LORD, the LORD did not answer him, either by dreams or by Urim or by the prophets.

entries.title: I Samuel 28:7
segments: ¶Then Saul said to his servants, "Find me a woman who is a medium, that I may go to her and inquire of her." And his servants said to him, "In fact, [there is] a woman who is a medium at En Dor."

entries.title: I Samuel 28:8
segments: So Saul disguised himself and put on other clothes, and he went, and two men with him; and they came to the woman by night. And he said, "Please conduct a seance for me, and bring up for me the one I shall name to you."

entries.title: I Samuel 28:9
segments: Then the woman said to him, "Look, you know what Saul has done, how he has cut off the mediums and the spiritists from the land. Why then do you lay a snare for my life, to cause me to die?"

entries.title: I Samuel 28:10
segments: And Saul swore to her by the LORD, saying, "[As] the LORD lives, no punishment shall come upon you for this thing."

entries.title: I Samuel 28:11
segments: Then the woman said, "Whom shall I bring up for you?" And he said, "Bring up Samuel for me."

entries.title: I Samuel 28:12
segments: When the woman saw Samuel, she cried out with a loud voice. And the woman spoke to Saul, saying, "Why have you deceived me? For you [are] Saul!"

entries.title: I Samuel 28:13
segments: And the king said to her, "Do not be afraid. What did you see?" And the woman said to Saul, "I saw a spirit ascending out of the earth."

entries.title: I Samuel 28:14
segments: So he said to her, "What [is] his form?" And she said, "An old man is coming up, and he [is] covered with a mantle." And Saul perceived that it [was] Samuel, and he stooped with [his] face to the ground and bowed down.

entries.title: I Samuel 28:15
segments: ¶Now Samuel said to Saul, "Why have you disturbed me by bringing me up?" And Saul answered, "I am deeply distressed; for the Philistines make war against me, and God has departed from me and does not answer me anymore, neither by prophets nor by dreams. Therefore I have called you, that you may reveal to me what I should do."

entries.title: I Samuel 28:16
segments: Then Samuel said: "Why then do you ask me, seeing the LORD has departed from you and has become your enemy?

entries.title: I Samuel 28:17
segments: "And the LORD has done for Himself as He spoke by me. For the LORD has torn the kingdom out of your hand and given it to your neighbor, David.

entries.title: I Samuel 28:18
segments: "Because you did not obey the voice of the LORD nor execute His fierce wrath upon Amalek, therefore the LORD has done this thing to you this day.

entries.title: I Samuel 28:19
segments: "Moreover the LORD will also deliver Israel with you into the hand of the Philistines. And tomorrow you and your sons [will be] with me. The LORD will also deliver the army of Israel into the hand of the Philistines."

entries.title: I Samuel 28:20
segments: ¶Then immediately Saul fell full length on the ground, and was dreadfully afraid because of the words of Samuel. And there was no strength in him, for he had eaten no food all day or all night.

entries.title: I Samuel 28:21
segments: And the woman came to Saul and saw that he was severely troubled, and said to him, "Look, your maidservant has obeyed your voice, and I have put my life in my hands and heeded the words which you spoke to me.

entries.title: I Samuel 28:22
segments: "Now therefore, please, heed also the voice of your maidservant, and let me set a piece of bread before you; and eat, that you may have strength when you go on [your] way."

entries.title: I Samuel 28:23
segments: But he refused and said, "I will not eat." So his servants, together with the woman, urged him; and he heeded their voice. Then he arose from the ground and sat on the bed.

entries.title: I Samuel 28:24
segments: Now the woman had a fatted calf in the house, and she hastened to kill it. And she took flour and kneaded [it], and baked unleavened bread from it.

entries.title: I Samuel 28:25
segments: So she brought [it] before Saul and his servants, and they ate. Then they rose and went away that night.
